faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Indore Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) Marketing position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 20th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) Marketing role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have successfully defended their Ph.D. from a premier institute (excluding IIM Indore) within the last 5 years and have at least 60% marks or a 1st division in their master's degree.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for the Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF) Marketing position?
faq.answer: The position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. Which institute is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Indore (IIM Indore).

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 05/2026.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age limit restrictions for this post?
faq.answer: Specific age limits are not detailed in the provided summary. It is advisable to check the official notification for any age-related criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the desirable qualification for the PDF Marketing role?
faq.answer: A desirable qualification includes having at least a B category publication in an ABDC or equivalent journal list.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" heading.
